hero.subtitle: In the heart of Cappadocia, Ortahisar. Not a hotel — independent suite homes.

manifesto.title: Not a hotel. No shared spaces. Entirely yours.
manifesto.intro: Anitya Cave House consists of 3 independent suite homes within the same building. Two cave suites, one stone suite. All prepared exclusively for guests.

notARoom.title: Not a room.
notARoom.subtitle: An independent home.
notARoom.intro: Staying at Anitya is not about entering a room; it's about retreating to your own space.
notARoom.closing: You don't share space with anyone. You set the pace of the day.

kitchen.label: KITCHEN
kitchen.title: A real kitchen in every suite.
kitchen.lead: This is not an "amenity"; it's freedom and independence.
kitchen.p1: Refrigerator, oven, stove, kettle, coffee machine, traditional tea pot... Pots, pans, plates, various glasses and complete cutlery set.
kitchen.p2: Upon arrival, you are welcomed with unlimited filter coffee, Turkish coffee and black tea, olive oil and basic spices.
kitchen.closing: At Anitya, the kitchen is not an accessory.
kitchen.closingEmphasis: It's part of the living experience.

terrace.label: TERRACE
terrace.title: Where the day begins.
terrace.p1: From our private terraces, you can see Cappadocia's rock formations, valleys and dovecotes, Ortahisar's stone houses, and on clear days, Mount Erciyes in the distance.
terrace.p2: When weather conditions are suitable, at sunrise
terrace.closing: The terrace is not a viewpoint.
terrace.secondaryCaption: Hot air balloons at sunrise when conditions allow

suites.title: Three suites. Three separate worlds.
suites.description: Each one different, each one independent.
